name: Dexcom G7
author: Boricuatec
description: Live Dexcom G7 glucose readings in the Omarchy bar via the Dexcom Share API, with color-coded high/low alerts, a recent-history tooltip, and a click-to-open popup graph.

barWidget.description: Current glucose reading, trend arrow, and a recent-history tooltip. Click to open a popup with a graph of recent readings. Colored by range: white/theme = normal, orange = low or high, red = urgent low or urgent high, gray = stale or errored.

schema.label: Credentials file
schema.description: Path to a chmod-600 file with DEXCOM_USERNAME and DEXCOM_PASSWORD. Leave empty to use ~/.config/omarchy-dexcom/credentials.env. See README for setup and required account type.

schema.label: Dexcom region
schema.description: share2 = United States, shareous1 = outside the US, share = Japan.

schema.label: Fallback poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: Dexcom publishes roughly every 5 minutes, so the widget schedules its next check for shortly after that - this value is only the retry cadence used on errors or while the sensor is stale, and a ceiling if a reading's timestamp ever looks wrong.

schema.label: Display units
schema.description: mgdl = mg/dL (US default), mmol = mmol/L (standard outside the US). Thresholds above are always entered in mg/dL regardless of this setting.

schema.label: Show recent-history line in tooltip
schema.description: Adds a "Last N min: lo-hi (direction)" line to the hover tooltip.

schema.label: History window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the tooltip's history summary looks. Ignored if the history line is off.

schema.label: Spell out the trend in the tooltip
schema.description: e.g. "rising" instead of the raw Dexcom trend code, alongside the arrow.

schema.label: Graph window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the popup graph (click the widget) looks. Fetched in the same call as the current reading, so this doesn't add extra API requests.
